world_class.basis: New authorial R6 design; broad structural plausibility only. No fossil/paleogeographic reconstruction claim is made.

source_context.use: Reference values for a deliberately Earth-scale analogue; values are rounded and are not asserted as R6 historical facts.

source_context.source: NASA Earth Facts and Milankovitch Cycles
source_context.use: 23.4 degrees is a fixed nominal design choice, not a reconstruction of 210 Ma obliquity.

spatial_contract.crs: EPSG:4326 coordinate semantics; spherical metric calculations use the declared R6 radius
spatial_contract.cell_area: Exact spherical band-sector area using R6 radius; not constant across latitude
spatial_contract.native_spatial_resolution: 1 degree nominal angular support; no claim of uniform linear resolution
spatial_contract.rationale: A1 and much R3 support are 2-degree reference/consumer grids. A 1-degree global base grid gives 64,800 cells and improves base spatial support while remaining suitable for the stated workstation class; this does not confer sub-grid realism or authorize upsampling of source evidence.
spatial_contract.source_adapter_policy: Preserve each provider's native grid, support, mask, and resolution. Any cross-grid operation requires a separately declared conservative/semantics-aware adapter and must retain coarse-parent-support labels.
prohibited: Nearest-neighbor replication described as new evidence
Bilinear or cubic upsampling described as higher-resolution evidence
Promotion of A1 values to canonical R6 state

initial_geography.connectivity: Spherical 8-neighbour land connectivity with longitude wrap and explicit polar adjacency; implementation must define pole handling and use it consistently.

sea_level_datum.definition: R6 authorial reference equipotential; elevations are relative to this datum.

initial_geography.coastline: Irregular, multiscale, non-fractal-claim coastline with bays, peninsulas, shelves only where the generator has a supported representation; no cell-scale noise masquerading as geomorphology.

land_elevation.support: Model-generated design state only; every value tagged AUTHORIAL_SYNTHETIC_INITIALIZATION and uncertainty-bearing.
land_elevation.hypsometry: bounded, continuous, multiscale distribution; no empirical 210 Ma elevation claim
land_elevation.orogeny: May be represented as a designed initial structural province, not as the result of a recovered tectonic history.

drainage.meaning: Complete supported land elevation and land/ocean topology suitable as input to a later drainage analysis; not a drainage network, flow, discharge, lake, runoff, or hydrology result.
drainage.depression_policy: Preserve plausible closed/endoreic basins; no blanket sink fill. A future drainage adapter must declare breach/conditioning rules and retain basin provenance.

domain_bootstrap.climate_role: NOT_REQUIRED_TO_GENERATE_T0_GEOGRAPHY; required later only when a climate consumer/physical transition is authorized
domain_bootstrap.hydrology_role: NOT_RUN_AT_T0; later hydrology requires compatible drainage-ready terrain, climate/water inputs, datum/boundary authority, and the R6 hydrology adapter
domain_bootstrap.climate: UNKNOWN_AT_T0; climate model/provider and age-specific forcing must be bound before values are produced
domain_bootstrap.hydrology: UNKNOWN_AT_T0; derive only after compatible topography, climate, water boundary and R6 hydrology adapter are authorized

deep.v0_5_calibration_role: REFERENCE/CALIBRATION_CANDIDATE_ONLY; not a complete 210 Ma Deep initial state or fundamental law bundle
deep.v0_6d_production_boundary: D1/D2 runtime, D1 state/variance and D2.2 hook remain required for the historical Deep-coupled replay described by the bridge contract

domain_bootstrap.biology: OUTSIDE_INITIAL_PHYSICAL_WORLD_MATERIALIZATION; no flora/fauna populations or resources at t0
domain_bootstrap.human_history: OUTSIDE_INITIAL_PHYSICAL_WORLD_MATERIALIZATION; no human population or management state at t0

time_and_evolution.endpoint_constraints: A1 and later R1-R3 frames are reference evidence only unless a separate authority binds exact fields and scope; never force-fit or interpolate them.
time_and_evolution.first_causal_consumer: R6_PHYSICAL_WORLD_EVOLUTION_ADAPTER (tectonic/geodynamic state plus terrain evolution); not yet registered, law-bound, benchmarked, or executable.
time_and_evolution.climate_and_hydrology_order: Physical initial geometry precedes climate/hydrology evaluation; subsequent coupling order and timestep require a separately versioned causal solver contract.

seed_lineage.child_stream: SHA256(root_digest || 0x00 || generator_version || 0x00 || domain_stream_name); first 128 digest bits interpreted unsigned big-endian integer
seed_lineage.bit_generator: NumPy PCG64; exact NumPy version and platform recorded in materialization manifest
seed_lineage.stream_policy: Independent named streams per domain; no shared mutable global RNG; no inherited HYBRID-1 seed 917231
seed_lineage.ensemble: No ensemble member/run is materialized by this specification; future ensembles require explicit member identity and uncertainty design.

runtime_and_resource_envelope.target_hardware_class: approximately 6 CPU cores / 12 threads, 32 GB RAM, consumer GPU optional
runtime_and_resource_envelope.architecture: Chunked/field-wise generation and validation; global static 1-degree fields are acceptable; do not allocate a dense global all-domains-by-all-times tensor.
runtime_and_resource_envelope.gpu: not required for initial geometry; any future use requires reproducible CPU/GPU parity and runtime binding
runtime_and_resource_envelope.runtime_identity: must be pinned and recorded by the future materializer; not selected here

NEEDS_EXTERNAL_SCIENTIFIC_BINDING: 210 Ma plate-motion/geodynamic law and any reference chronology
physical bathymetry/ocean-basin initialization if required by an ocean consumer
R6 Deep fundamental law and authorized initial state
age-specific solar/orbital/atmospheric forcing and climate authority
global ocean volume/eustatic sea level if physical coupling requires it
dated land/shoreline and event package applicability for post-t0 evolution
NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION_BENCHMARK: spherical plate-mosaic and supercontinent geometry generator calibration
terrain hypsometry, relief spectra, and drainage-readiness tests
CPU runtime/memory and determinism on target hardware
1-degree spherical connectivity, area, coast, and seam/pole invariants
NEEDS_PROVIDER: No provider selected. A provider suitability review is required only when a consumer variable requires one and ARCANA canonical evidence is insufficient.
